summary_md: **GiveMePrompts ([@GiveMePromptsHQ](https://x.com/GiveMePromptsHQ/status/2115952107857846286))** made **Crew Cut**, a party game where phones join, selfies become characters, everyone secretly directs a scene and the TV premieres the film, built in ComfyUI on a MacBook with FLUX.2 klein and LTX-Video ([GiveMePrompts/crew-cut](https://github.com/GiveMePrompts/crew-cut)).
